1.why: The UI utilizes a clean, legible sans-serif font with standard spacing.

2.why: Text throughout the flow avoids italics, all-caps, and dense text blocks.

3.why: The UI displays a desktop-oriented layout rather than a mobile view.

4.why: Instructions are brief, direct, and expressed in plain language.

5.why: Input fields do not provide visual placeholders or format examples.

6.why: User instructions consist of short lines without long text blocks.

7.why: Dedicated copy action buttons for codes and secrets are absent.

8.why: The authenticator setup provides a text secret without a QR code option.

9.why: Standard inputs are present, though browser autofill support is unverified.

10.why: Primary buttons stand out clearly with high-contrast styling.

11.why: Each screen focuses the user on a single primary action.

12.why: Status updates appear in headings, though secondary detail relies on log boxes.

13.why: Code regeneration exists, but explicit toggle controls for visibility are missing.

14.why: No user-facing error messages or recovery guidance are illustrated.

15.why: No visible countdown timers or operational time limits are displayed.
